bagPolicy.summary: Baylor applies a clear-bag policy to ticketed athletics events: one clear bag up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches, a one-gallon clear freezer bag, or a clutch up to 4 x 6 inches.
allowed: Clear bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
